title: pouteria maclayana
intro: Pouteria maclayana, commonly known as Dabai or Malabar plum, is a tropical fruit-bearing tree native to the tropical regions of Southeast Asia. The fruit of Pouteria maclayana has been reported to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering cholesterol levels. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria maclayana include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
